meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为仓库生成分层的 AGENTS.md,让编码助手一进门就懂项目结构和约定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次都要向 AI 编码助手重复交代项目结构和命令
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep re-explaining project structure and commands to AI coding agents

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为项目生成分层的 AGENTS.md 知识库:先探查目录结构、代码符号和已有文档,再按复杂度打分决定在根目录和哪些子目录写 AGENTS.md。
howto.when: 当你要求为仓库初始化或更新 AGENTS.md,或提到需要把仓库的结构、命令、约定记录下来给 agent 用时触发。

say.note: 随后进入探索、打分、生成、复查四阶段
先读旧文件保留上下文,再全部删除重写

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base: it explores directory structure, code symbols and existing docs, then scores directories to decide where to write AGENTS.md — root plus qualifying subdirs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to initialize or update a repo's AGENTS.md, or when a repo needs its structure, commands and conventions documented for agents.

say_en.text: /init-deep to generate AGENTS.md for this repo
say_en.note: then runs discovery, scoring, generate, review
reads existing files first to keep context
